figures.caption: Sequence tag-based screen of cyclomarin/rufomycin-like BGCs. a) The structures and BGCs of cyclomarin A and rufomycin I. b) Phylogenetic tree of all A-domains from cyclomarin A and rufomycin I BGCs. p-Trp, ADH and AHA represent N-(1,1-dimethyl-1-allyl)Trp, 3-amino-3,5-dimethyl-4-hexenoic acid and 2-amino-4-hexenoic acid, respectively. c) Pipeline for the discovery of cyclomarin/rufomycin congeners from the soil metagenome. eDNA isolated from ∼2000 unique soils was screened by PCR using universal A-domain degenerate primers.
